The employment outlook will be Moderate for correctional service officers (NOC 43201) in Newfoundland and Labrador for the 2025-2027 period.

The following factors contributed to this outlook:

  • Employment decline will lead to the loss of a few positions.
  • A moderate number of positions will become available due to retirements.
  • There are a moderate number of unemployed workers with recent experience in this occupation.

Media reports of difficulties filling vacancies in the corrections system have arisen, as a considerable number of people have recently retired or left this line of work. To add people to the workforce, the provincial government is making efforts to attract people into its Recruit Training Program. This would include the required completion of the Correctional Officer Certificate program at the Atlantic Police Academy in Prince Edward Island. Furthermore, plans to build a new 395-bed adult correction facility has been approved with a completion date of 2029. The project will employ 25 new correctional officers.
